name: Push button
summary: Reads a push button cleanly (one press = one press, no flicker). Wire it between a pin and GND; no resistor needed.
use: Button btn(2); setup: btn.begin(); loop: if (btn.pressed()) {...}

points.note: Debouncing: a button's metal contacts bounce for a few milliseconds, so the reading must be steady for 30 ms before it counts.
